## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from OUP publisher pages and domain knowledge of National Academy of Neuropsychology (NAN) editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Low-Medium — paradigm-unified |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — cultural / cross-linguistic neuropsychology |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Clinical neuropsychology practice — neuropsychological assessment, forensic neuropsychology, performance validity testing (PVT), TBI clinical, dementia clinical |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **clinical neuropsychology practice contribution** — NAN-affiliated clinical, forensic, assessment-practice focus.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure experimental neuropsychology redirected to JCEN; pure cognitive neuroscience redirected to JoCN.

|--------|---------------------|----------|
| Quantitative experimental | 5 | Core |
| Qualitative interviews | 1 | Rare |
| Autoethnography | 0 | Outside scope |
| Theoretical / Conceptual | 2 | With clinical implications |
| Mixed methods | 2 | Quant-dominant |
| Meta-analysis | 5 | Welcomed |
| Assessment validation | 5 | Distinctive strength |
| Performance validity (PVT) | 5 | Distinctive strength |

Reviewers from NAN (National Academy of Neuropsychology) and broader clinical neuropsychology practice community. Common demands: "Clinical practice relevance?", "Assessment validity?", "Forensic applicability?".

| **Reviewer competence variance** | Medium |
| **Quantitative mindset bias on qualitative work?** | Yes |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without clinical neuropsychology practice focus
- AI use without disclosure per OUP policy
- Pure experimental neuropsychology without clinical practice

### Soft Tax

Low for NAN clinical practice tradition.

### Best Suited For

- Clinical neuropsychological assessment research
- Forensic neuropsychology
- Performance validity testing (PVT) research
- TBI / dementia clinical neuropsychology
- Cross-cultural assessment validation
- NAN-community clinical practice research

### Not Recommended For

- Pure experimental neuropsychology (consider JCEN)
- Pure cognitive neuroscience (consider JoCN)
- Pure cognitive psychology

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Clinical and Experimental Neuropsychology](./journal-of-clinical-and-experimental-neuropsychology.md) | INS peer; T&F |
| 2 | [Neuropsychology](./neuropsychology.md) | APA Division 40 |
| 3 | *(Clinical Neuropsychologist — community contribution welcome)* | T&F NAN peer journal |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JCEN as "too clinical-practice / not experimental enough," ACN is the OUP NAN-affiliated home for clinical neuropsychology practice.
